## Description {#details}

<p>Represents overflowing add/sub operations.</p>


<p>Only carry-out: G_UADDO, G_SADDO, G_USUBO, G_SSUBO Carry-in and carry-out: G_UADDE, G_SADDE, G_USUBE, G_SSUBE</p>
